# Aerovant Technologies

> Aerovant Technologies is a cybersecurity and software company based in Krishnagiri, Tamil Nadu, India. We build ThreatReady, a platform to train, test and hire security engineers, and deliver cloud security (AWS), VAPT and managed security services to startups, SaaS companies and SMEs.

Based in Rayakkottai Road, Krishnagiri, Tamil Nadu 635002, India. Contact: admin@aerovanttech.com, +91 90426 47714. We reply within one business day.

Key facts:
- What we build: ThreatReady (cybersecurity skills platform, https://threatready.io/).
- What we secure: AWS cloud environments, web applications, APIs and networks.
- Who we help: founders, CTOs and engineering heads at startups, SaaS companies and SMEs.
- Services: Cloud Security (also: AWS security audit, AWS security assessment, cloud security assessment services, AWS cloud security services); Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (also: VAPT services in India, VAPT audit, penetration testing services, web application penetration testing, API security testing, network penetration testing); Managed Security Services (also: managed security services provider (MSSP), SOC as a Service, managed SOC services, managed EDR, WAF management).
- ThreatReady covers: cybersecurity interview preparation, cyber security mock interview, SOC analyst interview preparation, cybersecurity skills assessment, cybersecurity hands-on labs.

## Services
- [Cybersecurity services](https://aerovanttech.com/services/): Cybersecurity services for startups, SaaS companies and SMEs in India: VAPT and penetration testing, AWS cloud security, and managed security (SOC).
- [Cloud Security](https://aerovanttech.com/services/cloud-security/): AWS security audit and cloud security assessment for startups and SMEs in India. See what is exposed in your AWS account and what to fix first.
- [VAPT: Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing](https://aerovanttech.com/services/vapt/): VAPT services in India: web application penetration testing, API security testing and network VAPT audits, with evidence and fix guidance for each finding.
- [Managed Security Services](https://aerovanttech.com/services/managed-security/): Managed security services and SOC as a Service: EDR, firewall and WAF management, and threat advisories for startups and SMEs in India.

## Product
- [ThreatReady](https://aerovanttech.com/products/): ThreatReady: cybersecurity interview preparation, hands-on labs and skills assessment across 15 roles, including SOC analyst. Train, test and hire engineers.
- [ThreatReady website](https://threatready.io/): Train, test and hire security engineers on real work, not on certificates.

- [eMudhra: The Certificate Scare That Ended in a Day, and the Deadline That Didn’t](https://aerovanttech.com/insights/emudhra-certificate-incident/): The eMudhra certificate incident: Chrome drops emSign ECC Root CA - G3 on 27 Oct. - [php2shell: The PHP Bug That Fires Before Your Code Runs](https://aerovanttech.com/insights/php2shell/): php2shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619): the latest PHP vulnerability allows unauthenticated RCE. Who is affected, a 10-minute check, and the fix. (Threat Intelligence, 2026-10-23)
